parameters.content: Today, 5/9/26, was a very productive session. I successfully installed GLPI 11 and N8N on Docker Desktop on Windows, overcoming several technical challenges along the way — including a port 80 conflict that I resolved by switching to port 8080, and a 2FA authentication issue that I fixed by creating a dedicated local API account. I then activated the GLPI REST API, created an API client with a proper App Token, and configured N8N with the correct headers to establish a live connection between the two platforms. By the end of the session, N8N was successfully communicating with GLPI via the REST API, which is the foundation for all the automation workflows planned in the project — including automatic ticket creation, email notifications, proactive monitoring, and the AI agent integration.
